picks.title: LitPivot: Developing research ideas through dynamic contextualization within the literature landscape
picks.excerpt: Ai2's LitPivot helps researchers refine early research ideas through literature-supported critiques and revisions that update as a proposal evolves.
picks.rationale: Research-method slot: LitPivot is a new Ai2 research-ideation tool that critiques and revises an early proposal against the literature as it changes. It covers a different step of the research process from AstaBrief report generation (10-08), Deep Review document analysis (10-15) and NYU's citation-hallucination checker (10-24).

picks.title: Low-power neural chip reads brain signals to identify cognitive and emotional states
picks.excerpt: EPFL's LogSync implantable chip measures brain oscillations and cross-region synchrony and uses on-chip machine learning to classify cognitive and emotional states; it was tested on recorded human data and in rats (IEEE JSSC).
picks.rationale: Neurotech hardware slot: EPFL's LogSync chip runs on-chip ML that classifies brain states from synchrony features (IEEE JSSC). It was tested only on recorded data and in rats, with no patients, clinicians or regulators involved, so it stays in science. It is distinct from the 09-30 stacked AI chip and the 10-03 brain-scan reconstruction.

picks.title: PerturbAI and OpenAI launch AI reasoning agents for biomedical discovery
picks.excerpt: A year-long collaboration between PerturbAI and OpenAI produced a reasoning framework in which thousands of agents turn perturbation datasets into testable biological hypotheses; the partners are now extending it to drug-target discovery on PerturbAI's causal data.
picks.rationale: AI-scientist slot: a new agent framework turns perturbation data into testable biological hypotheses. No specific disease or patient is involved, so it stays in science. It is a separate launch from the 10-01 AI scientist, Quine (10-05) and Google's wet-lab agents (10-21).

picks.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
picks.excerpt: OlmoEarth v1.3 brings state-of-the-art satellite embeddings, precomputed global data and a browser-based Embeddings Explorer for mapping and analysing the planet.
picks.rationale: Open-model release slot: a new version of OlmoEarth with precomputed global embeddings and a browser Embeddings Explorer that researchers can use today. It is a different product from DeepMind's ForTy forest map (10-24) and Google's Earth AI posts.

picks.title: Most AI chatbots stay in the political middle ground, with Grok being an exception
picks.excerpt: Chalmers researchers had six LLMs write about 107 Swedish political issues before the 2026 election; most landed near the centre without favouring a party, while Grok diverged on migration, crime and gender (arXiv preprint).
picks.rationale: LLM-behavior slot: a Chalmers audit of six LLMs on 107 Swedish policy issues, with Grok as the measured outlier. This is a social-science measurement study, not policy news. It differs from the 10-11 climate-policy endorsement study and the 10-21 synthetic-polling card.
